user.title: Set up TCL Matter
user.description: TCL Matter decodes vendor-specific Matter clusters used by TCL dehumidifiers. The integration auto-discovers TCL devices already commissioned to your Matter fabric — no input is needed.

abort.matter_not_loaded: The Matter integration is not set up. Set it up and pair the dehumidifier first, then add TCL Matter.
